user_request: 発音のテンポを一定にする,音の高さ低さを一定の範囲にする
method: Local tempo normalization and bounded pitch-contour compression of existing recordings

settings.mora_count_method: pykakasi reading, small vowels/ya/yu/yo excluded; a phrase-average pacing proxy, not phoneme alignment
settings.pitch_mapping: For each sentence, center on 215 Hz and compress deviations with 3*tanh(0.45*semitones/3).
